list.title: Uploads
list.description: Sessions uploaded by the desktop app at your clinics. Each upload is checked on arrival; review the ones that need attention and mark them for analysis.
list.csvFailed: Could not export the CSV file.
list.emptyHint: Try a wider date range, or

attention.label: Needs attention
attention.hint: invalid, flagged, crash, mic loss or non-standard computer

filters.searchPlaceholder: Patient code, session ID or computer

recovered.label: Recovered
recovered.hint: App crashed; session rebuilt and may be incomplete

skipped.label: Skipped tasks
skipped.hint: One or more tasks skipped by the examiner

retakes.label: Retakes
retakes.hint: A task was repeated; only the last take is exported

edited.label: Edited timeline
edited.hint: Segment boundaries adjusted in the waveform editor

outdated.label: Old config
outdated.hint: Recorded with a config version older than the current one

late.label: Late upload
late.hint: Uploaded more than 3 days after recording

duplicate.label: Re-sent
duplicate.hint: Computer re-sent an already received session

nonstdMic.label: Non-standard mic
nonstdMic.hint: The whole session was recorded with a microphone other than the one set in the app's Settings

nonstdCam.label: Non-standard camera
nonstdCam.hint: The whole session was filmed with a camera other than the one set in the app's Settings

device.label: Computer event
device.hint: A camera or microphone failed during the session

session.notFoundBody: This session does not exist or is outside your access. The server answers the same either way, so it never confirms that the record exists.
session.errorBody: The server did not answer as expected. Please try again.
session.downloadHint: Saved as {{id}}.zip. The computer's own file name starts with the patient code, so the server neither logs nor reuses it.
session.viewOnlyHint: Your access to this study is read-only
session.title: Session
session.notFinishedHint: No end time was recorded: the session never finished cleanly. The time shown is when the app rebuilt it.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.sub: From the session summary. Clips are played from the server copy; nothing is downloaded.
tasks.lastKeptHint: Only the last take is exported
tasks.micLostHint: Microphone lost during this task (take rejected: DEVICE_LOST)
tasks.videoNoSound: Play video (the MP4 has no sound track)
tasks.viewOnlyNote: Playing clips needs edit rights for this session.

timeline.title: Recording timeline
timeline.aria: Task segments along the master recording

desc.zip_checksum: SHA-256 of the file matches the value declared by the computer
desc.archive: The archive is readable and has the expected structure
desc.manifest: Every file is present and matches manifest.json
desc.ids: Session and installation IDs agree across the files
desc.device: The computer has a registered installation ID
desc.config_version: The config version is the current one

history.title: Upload history
history.sub: Every request the server received for this session ID

review.title: Review
review.addComment: Add a comment for the clinic team
review.placeholder: e.g. Phonation take 2 clipped, please re-record at next visit
review.forbidden: You only have read access to this session.
review.viewOnlyNote: View only. Downloading, revealing participant fields, changing the review status and commenting need an assignment to this clinic or edit rights on the study.

participant.title: Participant
participant.note: As typed at the clinic. Fields other than the patient code and visit are hidden.
participant.noteEdit: As typed at the clinic. Fields other than the patient code and visit stay hidden until you choose to show them. Each reveal is recorded in the audit log. Editing corrects typos: new values replace the old ones on every page and in later downloads, and every change is written to the audit log.

errors.forbidden: You only have read access to this session.
errors.required_field: Patient code and visit cannot be empty.
errors.invalid_value: A value is invalid (text of at most 255 characters).
errors.invalid_fields: The fields could not be read.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.sub: Everything uploaded by the computers at your clinics.
recordings.selectAll: Select all recordings on this page

blocked.readOnly: You can review this recording but not download it

recordings.emptyBody: They appear here when a clinic computer uploads its first session.
recordings.banner_one: {{count}} computer is not assigned to a clinic, and its recordings are in quarantine.
recordings.banner_other: {{count}} computers are not assigned to a clinic, and their recordings are in quarantine.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Patient code, session ID or computer

bulk.tooMany: That is {{count}} recordings, and one download holds at most {{max}}. Narrow the filter or tick fewer.
bulk.tooLarge: That is {{size}}, and one download holds at most {{maxSize}}. Tick fewer recordings.
bulk.nothing: Nothing here can be downloaded: recordings that are invalid, still being checked or view-only are left out.
